parent_objective: design source-balanced boundary export/tooling after M1083 fixed success drops but failed physical-pair diversity
blocked_by: M1084 opened source_balanced_boundary_tooling because post-export robustness repeatedly found physical-pair concentration
invalidates: running another sampling retarget without source-balanced export logic
weakening robustness thresholds to accept M1083

public_gates: M1085 must not use private holdout
M1085 must preserve existing robustness thresholds
M1085 must specify how source balance is enforced before or during boundary export
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower min physical pairs or max pair dominance thresholds
do not redefine source diversity after seeing results

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers tooling requirements to address M1083 physical-pair concentration without weakening robustness
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no implementation, no mining, no training, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if design weakens robustness thresholds
stop if design cannot distinguish source-pair and relocated physical-pair diversity
stop if design only post-filters a six-physical-pair surface
fallback_plan: if design is accepted, implement source-balanced boundary tooling in M1086
if existing tooling already supports it, route to a no-code command redesign
if impossible without broader sampler changes, route to sampler/tooling implementation

hypothesis: A source-balanced boundary export tool can preserve M1083 success-drop quality while preventing accepted rows from collapsing to too few robustness physical pairs.
success_criteria: implementation milestone is pre-registered if needed
no training, PPO, mining, promotion, or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: design relies only on post-filtering a six-pair surface

designed_tooling: raw plus balanced accepted-row export artifacts
rejected_routes: post-filtering the six-physical-pair M1083 accepted set
another sampling-only retarget before source-balanced export tooling

decision_rule: M1085 may only design source-balanced boundary tooling. It cannot train, run PPO, mine rows, promote, use private holdout, or weaken robustness thresholds.
